title: Setup: changing a member's role silently auto-grants a permission set; the result never says a set was granted (#27521 row 14)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC

Filing gate: ② a wrong or confusing state shown to the user. Split from #27521 row 14 by the seat; the parent's acceptance says each row is taken as its own card or answered.

## Business reason

Who: every administrator changing a user's role. What happens: the role change grants a permission set as a side effect (e.g. `organization_admin_no_bypass` on the user's Permission Sets tab), but the result says nothing about it, so the administrator later finds a set on the user that nobody visibly assigned. Reach: every administrator changing a role.

## Mechanism

- The auto-grant runs server-side on the `sys_member` lifecycle (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-start-hooks.ts`, "Auto-grant `organization_admin` on sys_member lifecycle", line 438 on main; the variant choice in `auto-org-admin-grant.ts`); the role change's result returned to the console carries no line naming the granted set.
- The ui half (labels for these cells) is the sibling card split from the same row.

Read in the 18.3.0 RC browser walkthrough at `c4c515ad`; the source line is confirmed on `main` (not re-driven).

## Wanted

The role change that auto-grants a set says so in its result, naming the set by its label.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Changing a user's role that triggers an auto-grant returns a result naming the granted set's label.
- [ ] A role change that grants nothing shows no such line.

Refs #27521
